title: Multimodal Cultural Heritage Architectural Style Classification for Residential Buildings in the UAE Based on CLIP Embeddings and SVM
abstract: arXiv:2609.17181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The analysis and classification of cultural heritage architectural styles remain challenging due to the complexity of visual images of buildings, which are highly relied on in traditional CNN-based classification approaches in comparison to textual descriptions, and the relative lack of non-western region-specific datasets. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a multimodal machine learning framework to analyze and classify Emirati residential architecture using OpenAI's CLIP model. We integrate visual features from images and textual features from expert descriptions into a unified 512-dimensional embedding, followed by dimensionality reduction with UMAP for visualization and unsupervised clustering using K-Means. Cluster labels, which are derived from manual analysis of the K-Means clusters, are used to train an SVM classifier for automated architectural style classification. Our approach achieves a classification accuracy of 98

translated_title: 基于CLIP嵌入和SVM的阿联酋住宅建筑多模态文化遗产建筑风格分类
translated_abstract: 文化遗产建筑风格的分析与分类仍然具有挑战性，原因在于建筑视觉图像的复杂性——传统的基于CNN的分类方法高度依赖视觉图像而非文本描述，以及非西方地区特定数据集的相对缺乏。本文通过提出一个多模态机器学习框架来弥补这一空白，利用OpenAI的CLIP模型对阿联酋住宅建筑进行分析和分类。我们将来自图像的视觉特征和来自专家描述的文本特征整合到统一的512维嵌入中，随后使用UMAP进行降维以实现可视化，并使用K-Means进行无监督聚类。通过人工分析K-Means聚类得出的聚类标签被用于训练SVM分类器，以实现自动化的建筑风格分类。我们的方法达到了98%的分类准确率。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于CLIP嵌入与SVM的多模态框架，融合图像视觉特征与专家文本描述，实现了对阿联酋住宅建筑文化遗产风格的自动分类，准确率高达98%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal framework based on CLIP embeddings and SVM that integrates visual features with expert textual descriptions to automatically classify Emirati residential cultural heritage architectural styles with 98% accuracy.
